name: Bloodborne (bbport)
_note: Checked against the 0.7 zip (README-Windows.txt, run.py, scripts\game_check.py): bbport-run.exe is the port's own launcher (bbport_launcher_win, Russian-only window); --play starts the game with its saved settings (%APPDATA%\bbport-launcher\settings.json: language, game_dir) without the window, through run.py. Game language 1 = English (US), 8 = Russian (its default). BB_GAME_DIR is the game folder (eboot.bin and sce_sys\param.sfo at 01.09, the update copied over the base game). user\ holds the saves (user\savedata) and what the game writes for the player. Online only with BB_ONLINE=1, never set by Ionea. Not yet run with the real game.

video._note: bbport.ini next to the program (key=value, no sections), read by run.py and the game at start; its in-game menu (Insert / L3+R3) writes the same file. Values from scripts\patches.py (preset scales 1.0/1.5/1.7/2.0/3.0, anti_aliasing auto/game/fxaa/off/smaa, model_lod -2/0/1/2, effects 0/1). verify: upscaler names taa/fsr3/fsr4/dlss and low_latency on/off are only seen in bb-probe.exe's text and the shipped file; DLSS needs an NVIDIA card. Frame rate (BB_FPS) and texture_quality are not here yet.

sharedSaves._note: bbport's user\savedata\1\<id>\SPRJ0005 and shadPS4's user\home\1000\savedata\<id>\SPRJ0005 hold the same files (userdata0000-0010, backup0000/0010; same header and sizes). Shared (the default): each save folder here is a link to shadPS4's, per profile. Each keeps its own metadata (bbport: SPRJ0005.sce_sys\param.bin beside it; shadPS4: sce_sys\param.sfo inside). Game info > Saves: Shared / Separate.

addons._note: bb-probe.exe mounts add-ons from its --user folder (user\addcont\<title id>\<entitlement label>; its text has '%s/addcont', '%s/%s/%s' and the guest mount '/addcont%d'), the layout shadPS4 has. Without them its log says 'offline base-game profile, no mounted add-ons' and a save made with The Old Hunters asks for the DLC. At every native start Ionea links each add-on folder of the game's emulator (shadPS4's gameData addons: user\addcont\{gameid}\*, e.g. SPEXPANSIONDLC03, SPDLCMESSENGER00/01) here as a junction, in the active profile's user folder. The add-on folders hold only sce_sys (the licence); the content is in the 01.09 update.

perf._note: run.py sets BB_FRAME_STATS=1 and BB_FRAME_LOG=logs\<time>.frames.csv beside bbport-run.exe on Windows (unless BB_FRAME_STATS=off or BB_SAVE_LOG=0): one row per frame, t_s the frame's time in seconds. Ionea's overlay reads it for an exact frame rate (also above the monitor's refresh rate).
